SELECT p.id, p.name, p.category_id, p.price, p.status, p.main_image, p.sales_count, p.sort_order AS sortId, p.stock, p.create_time FROM t_product p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_coupon c WHERE c.id = #{couponId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND ( c.category = 1
OR ( c.category = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_coupon_scope cs WHERE cs.coupon_id = c.id AND cs.target_id = p.category_id ) )
OR ( c.category = 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_coupon_scope cs WHERE cs.coupon_id = c.id AND cs.target_id = p.id ) ) ) )
ORDER BY
p.price p.sales_count p.create_time p.sort_order
ASC DESC
ORDER BY p.sort_order DESC, p.create_time DESC

SELECT id, name, price, main_image, stock, sales_count AS saleCount, status = 1 AS isOnShelf, update_time FROM t_product WHERE is_deleted = 1
AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND status = 1
AND status = 0
ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT id, name, price, main_image AS mainImage, stock, sales_count AS saleCount, CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN true ELSE false END AS isOnShelf, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_product
AND is_deleted = 1
AND is_deleted = 0
AND status = 0
AND status = 1
AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY sort_order DESC, update_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.main_image, p.price, p.sales_count FROM t_product p JOIN t_order_item oi ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_no IN ( -- 子查询：找到所有包含目标商品的订单号 SELECT order_no FROM t_order_item WHERE product_id = #{productId} ) -- 排除当前商品自己 AND p.id != #{productId} -- 确保商品处于上架状态且未被删除 AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 -- 按共同购买的频率进行统计 GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY COUNT(oi.id) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
